steps.name: Domains
procedure_descriptions: For [C0026](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0026), the threat actors re-registered expired C2 domains previously used for [ANDROMEDA](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1074) malware.(Citation: Mandiant Suspected Turla Campaign February 2023)

steps.name: Data from Local System
procedure_descriptions: During [C0026](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0026), the threat actors collected documents from compromised hosts.(Citation: Mandiant Suspected Turla Campaign February 2023)

steps.name: Archive via Utility
procedure_descriptions: During [C0026](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0026), the threat actors used WinRAR to collect documents on targeted systems. The threat actors appeared to only exfiltrate files created after January 1, 2021.(Citation: Mandiant Suspected Turla Campaign February 2023)

steps.name: Ingress Tool Transfer
procedure_descriptions: During [C0026](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0026), the threat actors downloaded malicious payloads onto select compromised hosts.(Citation: Mandiant Suspected Turla Campaign February 2023)

steps.name: Dynamic Resolution
procedure_descriptions: During [C0026](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0026), the threat actors re-registered a ClouDNS dynamic DNS subdomain which was previously used by [ANDROMEDA](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1074).(Citation: Mandiant Suspected Turla Campaign February 2023)

steps.name: Data Transfer Size Limits
procedure_descriptions: During [C0026](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0026), the threat actors split encrypted archives containing stolen files and information into 3MB parts prior to exfiltration.(Citation: Mandiant Suspected Turla Campaign February 2023)

limitations: ATT&CK uses-links do not encode a historical total order; the compiler applies a declared tactic-rank policy.
Technique metadata constrains procedures but does not uniquely determine an executable target environment.
